title: pvPlotGlobalVariablesOverTime
body:
## pvPlotGlobalVariablesOverTime

Extracts global (field-data) quantities over time into a table with one row per time step, e.g. Exodus global variables such as total energy or time-step size. With AutoDetectGlobalTemporalDataArrays (ParaView default true), arrays flagged as Exodus global temporal variables are used if any exist; otherwise every single-tuple field-data array is collected by updating the input at each time step.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only field data is read; for point or cell arrays use pvPlotDataOverTime.
- Input without flagged arrays is updated at every time step, which can be slow for large cases.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `PlotGlobalVariablesOverTime`. Identity: `filters/ExtractFieldDataOverTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.
